evidence.commitSubject: fix: set inactivity-alerts cron to */30 schedule; add unit test
evidence.changesSummary: vercel.json: inactivity-alerts cron corrected from daily (0 9 * * *) to every-30-min (*/30 * * * *) per FR-5; duplicate inactivity-check entry at (0 9 * * *) removed. New 288-line unit test covers dedup, dry-run, and alert paths without Next.js.

mainCurrentState.conclusion: Both issues this branch fixes are still present on main

relatedPRs.title: Dev: fix-inactivity-alerting-cron-not-implemented
relatedPRs.note: Older PR for initial cron implementation. Commit message on orphan branch says a later conflicting re-merge restored the wrong daily schedule.

riskRationale: Only changes vercel.json cron schedule (config, not code logic) and adds a new test file. No business logic, no database changes, no API changes. Aligns with FR-5 requirement (every 30 min). Duplicate inactivity-check removal is safe cleanup. Note: every-30-min schedule will increase Vercel cron invocations vs daily — confirm Vercel plan supports this frequency.
recommendation: Ship this branch. Create a task and PR. The fix is valid, small, and self-contained. Main currently has the wrong schedule (daily instead of every 30 min per FR-5) and a stale duplicate cron entry. The branch also adds meaningful unit tests that main lacks. No known conflicts with any other branch.
